items.title: 9.5 Ionization constants of acids (Ka) (acids ke ionization constants) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 9.5 with Table 9.3, printed pages 195-196.

blocks.text: Pani mein dissolve hone (ghulne) par acids aur bases poori tarah dissociate (ions mein toot) ho bhi sakte hain aur nahi bhi. Bohat se acids weak electrolytes hain aur 100% se bohat kam ionize hote hain. Ka, jise acid ka dissociation constant kehte hain, acid ki strength (taqat) ka quantitative (number mein) measure (paimana) hai. Maan lein ek acid HA pani mein dissolve hai:
Is reversible reaction ka Kc yeh hoga:

Is equation se kisi bhi acidic solution ka Ka nikal sakte hain agar us ka pH ya [H⁺] aur acid ki initial (shuru ki) concentration [HA] maloom ho. Ulta, agar HA ki initial concentration aur us ka Ka maloom ho to equilibrium par H₃O⁺ aur A⁻ ki concentrations bhi nikal sakte hain.

items: Ka < 10⁻³ ho to acid weak (kamzor) hai.
Ka = 1 se 10⁻³ ho to acid moderately strong (darmiyana) hai.
Ka > 1 ho to acid strong (taqatwar) hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Table 9.3 mein kai ghaltiyan chhapi hain: (1) HCl, HNO₃ aur H₂SO₄ ko “very large” likh kar brackets mein 10⁻², 10⁻⁵ aur 10⁻² diya hai; strong acid ka Ka 1 se bohat zyada hota hai, is liye yeh ghalat hain. (2) HSO₄⁻ ka 1.3 × 10⁻⁴ chhapa hai; sahi taqreeban 1.2 × 10⁻² hai. (3) HF ka 6.7 × 10⁻⁵ chhapa hai; sahi taqreeban 6.8 × 10⁻⁴. (4) HCO₃⁻ ka 4.7 × 10⁻¹² chhapa hai; sahi 4.7 × 10⁻¹¹, aur CO₃²⁻ ka minus chhoot gaya hai. (5) H₂CO₃ ka dissociation “H⁺ + HS⁻” chhapa hai; sahi H⁺ + HCO₃⁻. (6) Ammonium “NH₄¹” aur product “NH₅” chhapa hai; sahi NH₄⁺ ⇌ H⁺ + NH₃. (7) Pani ka Ka 1.8 × 10⁻¹⁵ chhapa hai; kitab khud 9.3 mein 1.8 × 10⁻¹⁶ deti hai. (8) “Week” ki jagah “weak” hona chahiye.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Ka jitna bara, acid utna zyada ionize hota hai aur utna strong hai. Table mein upar se neeche Ka chhota hota jata hai, yani acid kamzor hota jata hai: HCl sab se strong, pani sab se kamzor.

items: Ka = Kc[H₂O] = [H₃O⁺][A⁻] / [HA]; yeh acid ki strength ka measure hai.
Ka < 10⁻³ weak, 1 se 10⁻³ moderately strong, Ka > 1 strong.
Table 9.3: HCl, HNO₃, H₂SO₄ bohat strong; HF, CH₃COOH (1.85 × 10⁻⁵), H₂CO₃, H₂S, NH₄⁺, HCO₃⁻ weak; pani bohat weak.
